Just now

--

Before the charts moved, before the influencers posted, before anyone claimed the AI sector was “heating up,” something quieter happened — something most analysts never saw.
A story appeared.
Not a headline. Not a prediction. Just a whisper:
“What if the next traders aren’t human?”
That whisper was the real beginning of the AI‑agent cycle — the ignition point that shaped everything that followed. Most articles start at price. But price is the last thing to move. Narrative is the first.
The World Bent Around the Story
Once the idea of autonomous trading agents took root, the ecosystem began to shift — quietly, almost imperceptibly.
Developers started building agent frameworks. Chains optimized for agent execution. VCs rewrote their internal memos. Exchanges prepared listings for tokens that didn’t exist yet.
None of this showed up in charts. But it showed up in behavior — the earliest sign of rotation.
Narrative doesn’t just describe the future. It reshapes the environment the future will grow inside.
The First Flicker of the Cycle
Weeks later, the first agent‑related tokens began to move.
Not because “AI was hot.” Not because of hype. But because the environment had already been bent by the narrative.
Liquidity wasn’t chasing gains. Liquidity was chasing the story — the belief that autonomous agents were the next evolution of on‑chain intelligence.
Most articles missed this. They saw momentum. They didn’t see ignition.
Because ignition doesn’t happen on the chart. It happens in the narrative.
